prior_exception.reason: The external Mathematics pathway is now verified at 180 EC under the current ordinary OER. The previous UCR no-match judgment was based partly on a superseded 48-EC line and an unsupported additional 12-EC mathematics requirement. Its independent reassessment is a separate stage; no updated no-match judgment or UCR comparison is asserted here.
prior_exception.curriculumContext: Current selected Wiskunde line: first year 54 required + 6 free; later 24 common + 36 line + 48 free + 12 thesis. Three specified line courses and three restricted choices preserve the mathematical core. The original exception and UCR evidence are preserved in the remediation register as historical assessment, not reused as an assessment of the corrected pathway.

cases.academic_assessment: Two defensible complete UCR programmes were constructed independently of the former no-match judgment. The corrected 54-EC total open profile supports a broader response without changing the selected external Wiskunde line. All specialist pure-mathematics gaps remain explicit; medical modelling, physics/astronomy and mathematics-teaching candidates were assessed separately and not used as filler. Each included course has a specific content-based trace; the alternatives differ by five courses / 37.5 EC.

external_source_verification.qualification: Current adopted PDF retrieved, text-extracted and relevant requirement table visually inspected; prior corrected components and neutral route retained.
